title: Reskin snail
statement: A hiker on a $26$ km mountain trail gains $5$ km each day and slides back $4$ km each night. Starting at the bottom on day $1$, on which day does the hiker first reach the $26$ km mark?
hints: Look at where the hiker is each morning.
The final day has no slide back.
solution: Each full day and night gains $1$ km. After $21$ days and nights the hiker is at $21$ km, and on day $22$ the hiker climbs $5$ km to reach $26$ km. Before that the daily peak is at most $25$ km, so day $22$ is the first time.
check_program:
pos, day = 0, 0
while True:
    day += 1
    pos += 5
    if pos >= 26:
        print(day)
        break
    pos -= 4
